title: K-th Smallest Prime Fraction
summary: Given a sorted array of 1 and prime numbers, find the k-th smallest fraction formed by dividing any two elements.
statement: Given a sorted array of 1 and prime numbers, find the k-th smallest fraction formed by dividing any two elements. Return the numerator and denominator of this fraction as an array.
constraints: arr starts with 1 followed by increasing primes; k indexes all i<j fractions.
Return numerator and denominator of the kth smallest fraction.
hints: For each denominator, fractions form an increasing list as numerator index grows.
Merge those sorted lists with a min-heap.
Seed 1/arr[j]; pop k-1 times and push the next numerator for that denominator.
Heap merging preserves global fraction order while storing only one frontier item per denominator.
editorial: Heap merging preserves global fraction order while storing only one frontier item per denominator.
